scope: W-018 real vanilla 26.3 observations, source freshness and production scan-only engine

checks.scenario: real private vanilla 26.3 server, checksum verified, loopback only
ten double chests, barrel, sign, shulker, bundle, named enchanted damaged item, crafting/anvil/staging fixtures
Docker Manager from explicit image with fresh volume and safe Owner setup, no Discord
external real 26.3 Fabric/Meteor/WeSort client connected to private server
overlapping actual vanilla menu opens are drained without issuing a falsely attributed observation
real normal/trapped/double chests and barrel have deterministic location identities; opposite double-chest halves produce one snapshot and no double count
real signed Fabric observations reach SQLite/Docker Manager with fresh observed/available stock and per-container revisions
actual QUICK_MOVE/return invalidates the old witness; only a new full server snapshot may make the source fresh again
real expiry policy marks last counts unknown and rejects a new reservation; pause/heartbeats do not renew observations
production StashSorter performs real rescan after expiry and observes the server delta with a newer Manager-issued revision
captured real older Fabric snapshot is rejected with 409 and cannot overwrite or renew newer physical observations
real obstructed double chest times out safely and becomes unreachable with unknown historical counts
real removed container retains source provenance as unknown and contributes zero orderable stock
real Manager restart preserves source history but blocks old stock until the Fabric production scanner performs new reads

limits: No global physical reservation hierarchy, kit/repack or completed guild order claim; those are later stage-3 issues.
